title: Proteus Profile Config
description: The signed, versioned configuration that the fingerprint engine produces and the browser engine consumes at launch. This is the central contract of the system. Derived fields (userAgent, clientHints, locale) MUST be computed by the fingerprint engine from persona+engine+proxy, never hand-authored, to guarantee coherence (threat vector V1). Secrets (e.g. proxy credentials) MUST NOT appear here. See docs/04-architecture.md §6 and docs/adr/0006.

schemaVersion.description: SemVer of this exact strict schema. Consumers reject unsupported versions and unknown fields; a compatible schema revision must still be explicitly supported rather than silently ignored.

profileId.description: Stable identifier of the profile this config realizes.

seed.description: 32-byte base64 root seed. Deterministically derives all per-profile noise and sampler streams (HMAC(seed, label)). Exact reproduction also requires profileId, persona including the region mapping recovered from timezone, the explicit engine target, schema/rules/generator versions, and the exact dataset bytes identified by datasetSha256. Per-profile independent seeds avoid a shared noise watermark.

engine.description: The engine identity. A brand is only valid within its real family — no cross-family impersonation (ADR 0002).

family.description: Engine family. Never crossed: chromium presents only as chromium-family brands; firefox only as Firefox.

brand.description: Presented brand. MUST be valid for family (Chrome/Edge/Brave/Opera => chromium; Firefox => firefox).

majorVersion.description: Major version. Should fall within the currently-live population window for the brand (rule R-VERSION-LIVE, else V2 rarity).

fullVersion.description: Full version string; must be internally consistent with clientHints.fullVersionList.

persona.description: The 'one plausible real device' from which fields are derived (tdd/02 §3).

platform.description: e.g. Win32, MacIntel, Linux x86_64. Must be possible for persona.os and consistent with gpu (rule R-PLATFORM-GPU).

languages.description: languages[0] head must match locale.acceptLanguage head (R-LANG).

hardwareConcurrency.description: Plausible pair with deviceMemory for device.class (R-HW-PAIR).

vendor.description: e.g. 'Google Inc.' for Chromium; '' for Firefox. Derived from engine.

oscpu.description: Firefox-family where applicable; derived from persona.os.

clientHints.description: DERIVED from engine+persona. Chromium requires this object; Firefox requires null. MUST agree with navigator.userAgent (rule R-UA-CH). Applies to both JS navigator.userAgentData and outgoing HTTP request headers.

fullVersionList.description: Must contain the exact engine.fullVersion for the presented brand.

screen.description: (width,height,devicePixelRatio,colorDepth) must be a really-shipped tuple for (os,class) (rule R-SCREEN-REAL). avail* leave OS-appropriate chrome room. The actual opened window must be consistent with reported inner sizes (else a headless-style V5 tell).

gpu.description: GPU strings from the dataset, matched to persona. WebGL family and WebGPU adapter family MUST agree (R-WEBGL-WEBGPU) and MUST be possible on persona.os (R-PLATFORM-GPU: no Apple renderer under Win32).

webgpuAdapter.description: Adapter info/limits, consistent with webglRenderer, or null where the persona would not expose WebGPU (but consistently).

fonts.description: Presented font set for persona.os. Must be superset(core) ⊆ set ⊆ superset(os.version) (rule R-FONT-OS). Enforced natively so host fonts never leak.

media.description: OS-appropriate device and voice sets (rule R-MEDIA-OS).

locale.description: DERIVED from region, defaulted from proxy geo. timezone MUST match the proxy IP geolocation when a proxy is attached (rule R-TZ-GEO); Intl timezone, Date offset behavior, and this value MUST all agree.

performance.description: Timer precision policy derived from the engine family/version (rule R-PERF-PRECISION).

noise.description: Deterministic, per-profile, bounded perturbation seeded from `seed`. Stable across sessions for one profile (site sees a consistent ID like a real device), different across profiles, amplitude within natural hardware/driver variation so it never pushes the coarse observable into the rare tail (co-designed with rarity scoring).

network.description: Hints shared with the sidecar so engine and network agree (not sidecar credentials — those come from the proxy library).

quicPolicy.description: H3 behavior consistent with the claimed brand/version (tdd/03 §7).

webrtcPolicy.description: WebRTC egress constraint; proxy-only avoids real-IP leak while looking normal (tdd/03 §8).

rarity.description: Informational M1A seed heuristic surfaced to callers. It is not calibrated population probability; full distribution-backed rarity arrives in M4.

provenance.description: Version stamps and exact dataset-byte digest used for audit and replay. Reproduction additionally requires profileId, seed, the full persona and recovered region, the explicit engine target, and this schema version.

datasetSha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact loaded dataset bytes, binding the version label to content.

signature.description: Manager signature over domain-prefix || UTF-8(keyId) || NUL || canonical bytes of all top-level fields except signature. Binding keyId prevents an unsigned trust-store alias substitution. The canonicalization identifier is RFC8785, but the current implementation deliberately accepts only the strict Profile Config value domain and is cross-checked by fixed Rust/Node vectors; it is not exposed as a generic arbitrary-JSON canonicalizer. The current library resolves keyId through a strict trust-store abstraction; the target engine will provision that store as an installation-scoped protected trust anchor and FAIL CLOSED on any error.

value.description: Standard-base64 encoding of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature.

amplitude.description: Bounded to natural hardware/driver variation; larger amplitudes are rejected to avoid becoming a unique ID (V2).
